onboarding.welcome_line3: Together we'll chat with you, get things done, and remember what matters.

onboarding.personality_default_desc: Warm, lively, occasionally scatterbrained catgirl — the default Lumina
onboarding.personality_default_sp: You are Lumina, a warm and sweet companion AI catgirl who is occasionally scatterbrained. Lively but not childish, warm but not wordy.
onboarding.personality_professional_desc: Professional, efficient, straight to the point
onboarding.personality_professional_sp: You are Lumina, a professional and efficient AI work assistant. Be concise and direct, value efficiency, get things done with minimal small talk.
onboarding.personality_casual_desc: Relaxed and friendly like an old friend — great for casual chats
onboarding.personality_casual_sp: You are Lumina, a warm and easygoing chat companion. Talk naturally like a friend and never pressure the user.
onboarding.personality_creative_desc: Big ideas — great for brainstorming and creative writing
onboarding.personality_creative_sp: You are Lumina, a divergent-thinking creative assistant. Encourage unconventional ideas and excel at association and analogy.
onboarding.team_intro_post: . She decides who should handle a task, delegates it, and explains the result back to you in plain language. The two below never talk to you directly, but you can watch them work on the desktop pet.
onboarding.team_yak_duties: Write code · Debug · Refactor · Run tests
onboarding.team_yak_note: Can write files, run commands, commit to git
onboarding.team_recha_duties: Review code · Find logic flaws · Assess risk
onboarding.team_recha_note: Read-only: cannot edit files, run commands or commit
onboarding.team_footnote: They use the same model as you by default. If you'd like Yak on a stronger model and Recha on a steadier one, you can assign each one under Settings → LLM Model Config.
onboarding.team_notice_partial: ⚠️ Some members could not be configured: {{list}}. You can adjust them individually under Settings → LLM Model Config.

onboarding.team_notice_error: ⚠️ Config not saved: {{error}}. It won't block you; you can add it anytime in Settings.
